newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real closes steady on strong dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real closes steady on strong dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real closed unchanged on Monday at 1.0831 per dollar on strong inflows of the U.S. currency in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
At 1635 local/1935 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $450 million surplus. On Friday, forex contracts posted a $572.2 million surplus.
Earlier Monday dealers expected part of the $1.6 billion paid last week for Bahia state electrical company Coelba CEE.BA to enter the market.
In late afternoon, the central bank bought dollars at 1.0830 each to drain excess dollars from the market.
Dealers expected dollar inflows to remain strong at least through the first half of the month.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed flat at 1.0886 per dollar. In the parallel market, the real ended unchanged at 1.140 per dollar.
